svg.text: AWS deployment architecture | Personal demonstration | Matches infra/cloudformation.yaml
Public subnets in both availability zones
Task: Spring Boot API on port 8080
Scheduled outbox delivery in each replica
Task: Spring Boot API on port 8080
Scheduled outbox delivery in each replica
Single RDS writer endpoint • TLS 5432 • Application security group only
NAT per AZ supports outbound pulls
No external bank or payment rails
CloudFormation provisions the VPC, ALB, WAF, ECS service, RDS, secrets, logs and DNS. ECR uses a separate bootstrap stack.
AWS service icons from the diagrams project asset library. AWS names and marks belong to Amazon Web Services.
